population.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')) SELECT cohort,count(*) retired,sum(retire_age<30) short,sum(retire_age>=30) eligible,sum(retire_age IS NULL) unknown_age,count(distinct CASE WHEN retire_age>=30 THEN profile_id END) profiles,sum(retire_age>=30 AND public_name IS NOT NULL) public_eligible,sum(json_type(snapshot_json,'$.style') IS NOT NULL) style,sum(json_type(snapshot_json,'$.potential') IS NOT NULL) potential FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') GROUP BY cohort

summary.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,sum(legend_score>=840) goat,sum(peak>=90) peak90,sum(peak>=95) peak95,sum(retire_age>=40) age40,sum(retire_age=41) age41,round(100.0*sum(retire_age>=40 AND legend_score>=840)/sum(legend_score>=840),2) goat_age40_pct FROM c GROUP BY cohort

quantiles.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , ranked AS (SELECT cohort,legend_score,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY cohort ORDER BY legend_score) rn,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY cohort) n FROM c), ps(p) AS (VALUES(25),(50),(75),(90),(95),(98),(99)) SELECT cohort,p,min(legend_score) score FROM ranked CROSS JOIN ps WHERE rn>=((n*p+99)/100) GROUP BY cohort,p

thresholds.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , v(threshold) AS (VALUES(840),(1200),(1400),(1500),(1600),(1800),(2000)) SELECT cohort,threshold,count(*) n,sum(legend_score>=threshold) reached,round(100.0*sum(legend_score>=threshold)/count(*),2) pct,round(100.0*sum(legend_score>=threshold AND public_name IS NOT NULL)/sum(public_name IS NOT NULL),2) public_pct,count(distinct CASE WHEN legend_score>=threshold THEN profile_id END) owners,count(distinct profile_id) profiles FROM c CROSS JOIN v GROUP BY cohort,threshold

positions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , ranked AS (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY cohort,pos ORDER BY legend_score) rn,count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY cohort,pos) total FROM c) SELECT cohort,pos,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,min(CASE WHEN rn>=(total*95+99)/100 THEN legend_score END) p95,max(legend_score) max_ls,sum(legend_score>=840) goat,sum(legend_score>=1600) above1600,sum(legend_score>=2000) above2000,round(avg(ballon),3) ballon FROM ranked GROUP BY cohort,pos

traits.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,pos,trait,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,round(100.0*avg(legend_score>=840),2) goat_pct,round(avg(retire_age),1) age FROM c GROUP BY cohort,pos,trait

peaks.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,CASE WHEN peak<80 THEN '<80' WHEN peak<85 THEN '80-84' WHEN peak<90 THEN '85-89' WHEN peak<95 THEN '90-94' ELSE '95+' END band,count(*) n,round(100.0*avg(legend_score>=840),2) goat_pct FROM c GROUP BY cohort,band

components.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,CASE WHEN legend_score<840 THEN '<840' WHEN legend_score<1600 THEN '840-1599' ELSE '1600+' END band,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,round(avg(awards*12),1) award_points,round(avg(trophies*10),1) trophy_points,round(avg(ballon*60),1) ballon_points,round(avg(peak*2),1) peak_points,round(avg(retire_age),1) age FROM c GROUP BY cohort,band

titles.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,json_extract(j.value,'$.id') earned,count(distinct c.id) n,count(distinct CASE WHEN title=json_extract(j.value,'$.id') THEN c.id END) displayed FROM c,json_each(c.snapshot_json,'$.titles') j WHERE json_extract(j.value,'$.id') IN ('lg_goat','ballon','ballon3','ovr90','treble','st_rehab_strong','oneclub') GROUP BY cohort,earned

paired.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , p AS (SELECT cohort,profile_id,avg(CASE WHEN trait='late' THEN legend_score END) late,avg(CASE WHEN trait='early' THEN legend_score END) early FROM c WHERE pos='FW' GROUP BY cohort,profile_id) SELECT cohort,count(*) profiles,round(avg(late-early),1) late_minus_early,round(100.0*avg(late>early),1) late_better_pct FROM p WHERE late IS NOT NULL AND early IS NOT NULL GROUP BY cohort

growth.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , per AS (SELECT c.cohort,c.id,c.trait,min(CASE WHEN s.ovr>=80 THEN s.age END) a80,min(CASE WHEN s.ovr>=90 THEN s.age END) a90,count(s.year) seasons FROM c LEFT JOIN career_seasons s ON s.career_id=c.id GROUP BY c.cohort,c.id,c.trait) SELECT cohort,trait,count(*) n,count(a80) reach80,round(avg(a80),1) age80,count(a90) reach90,round(avg(a90),1) age90,round(avg(seasons),1) seasons FROM per GROUP BY cohort,trait

attempts.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , ranks AS (SELECT id,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY profile_id ORDER BY retired_at,id) attempt FROM r WHERE retire_age>=30) SELECT cohort,CASE WHEN attempt=1 THEN '1' WHEN attempt<=3 THEN '2-3' WHEN attempt<=5 THEN '4-5' ELSE '6+' END attempt,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,round(100.0*avg(legend_score>=840),1) goat_pct FROM c JOIN ranks USING(id) GROUP BY cohort,CASE WHEN attempt=1 THEN '1' WHEN attempt<=3 THEN '2-3' WHEN attempt<=5 THEN '4-5' ELSE '6+' END

days.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT date(retired_at,'+9 hours') day,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,round(100.0*avg(legend_score>=840),2) goat_pct FROM c WHERE cohort='cumulative' GROUP BY day

versions.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT cohort,app_version,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls FROM c GROUP BY cohort,app_version

signals.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) , sig AS (SELECT c.cohort,c.id,c.legend_score,max(s.signals_json IS NOT NULL) measured,max(CASE WHEN json_valid(s.signals_json) THEN coalesce(json_extract(s.signals_json,'$.webdriver'),0) OR coalesce(json_extract(s.signals_json,'$.headless'),0) OR coalesce(json_extract(s.signals_json,'$.synthetic'),0)>0 ELSE 0 END) flagged FROM c LEFT JOIN career_seasons s ON s.career_id=c.id GROUP BY c.cohort,c.id,c.legend_score) SELECT cohort,CASE WHEN flagged THEN 'signal_not_proof' WHEN measured THEN 'recorded_no_signal' ELSE 'unobserved' END category,count(*) n,round(avg(legend_score),1) ls,sum(legend_score>=840) goat,sum(legend_score>=1600) above1600 FROM sig GROUP BY cohort,category

awards.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT * FROM careers WHERE status='retired' AND retired_at<'2026-09-29T01:30:00.000Z'), labels(cohort) AS (VALUES('baseline_requery'),('increment'),('cumulative')), c AS (SELECT r.*,labels.cohort FROM r CROSS JOIN labels WHERE retire_age>=30 AND (cohort='cumulative' OR (cohort='baseline_requery' AND retired_at<'2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z') OR (cohort='increment' AND retired_at>='2026-09-28T10:00:00.000Z'))) SELECT json_extract(j.value,'$.t') award,count(*) awards FROM c,json_each(c.snapshot_json,'$.awards') j WHERE cohort='cumulative' AND legend_score>=1600 GROUP BY award ORDER BY awards DESC LIMIT 10

active_balance.sql: SELECT version,status FROM balance_versions WHERE status='active'
